Net purchases of US stocks and investment fund shares by foreign investors surged 62% year over year to $426B in Q2, a quarterly record.
The $942B in net purchases of US equities and fund shares from foreigners from July 31, 2025 to July 31, 2026, is also a record.
At the same time, foreign appetite for US debt declined. Overseas investors bought a net $188B of debt in Q2, compared to $314B in the first, according to data from the Bureau of Economic Analysis.
Through July, foreign investors were net buyers for a sixth straight months.

title: Foreign capital investment into US equities hits record
